season_playoff_dates_check.name: season_playoff_dates_check
season_playoff_dates_check.value:
(
        "seasons"."playoff_start_date" IS NULL
        OR ("seasons"."playoff_start_date" >= "seasons"."start_date" AND "seasons"."playoff_start_date" <= "seasons"."end_date")
      ) AND (
        "seasons"."playoff_end_date" IS NULL
        OR ("seasons"."playoff_end_date" >= "seasons"."start_date" AND "seasons"."playoff_end_date" <= "seasons"."end_date")
      ) AND (
        "seasons"."playoff_start_date" IS NULL
        OR "seasons"."playoff_end_date" IS NULL
        OR "seasons"."playoff_end_date" >= "seasons"."playoff_start_date"
      )

team_membership_jersey_uniq.name: team_membership_jersey_uniq
team_membership_jersey_uniq.where: "team_memberships"."effective_to" IS NULL AND "team_memberships"."jersey_number" IS NOT NULL

game_slot_uniq.name: game_slot_uniq
game_slot_uniq.where: slot_id IS NOT NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','postponed')
